item.title: If AI replaces workers, should it also pay taxes?
item.description:
📝 Fewer people working means fewer taxpayers, so the question naturally arises: if machines and algorithms replace humans in their jobs, should they also have to cover the taxes that humans stop paying. We should continue taxing what already exists: income from labor, consumption, and capital gains. This system incentivizes companies to invest more in automation than in job-creatin.
🔗 Read more: https://english.elpais.com/technology/2025-11-30/if-ai-replaces-workers-should-it-also-pay-taxes.html
